messages:
maya: Quick thread  planning a short webinar + launch posts to drive the free-credits PLG experiment. Need: gating rules, two headline variants, which 3 starter prompts, and the analytics events. 15m?
jon: +1. Propose Fri 9am PT. CTA should be a claim button that writes a cohort cookie so we can route immediately.
sam: Two headline drafts: 1) Benchmark hook: 'Live demo: cut inference cost 3x + credits' 2) Starter hook: 'Starter prompts + free credits to ship your first LLM feature'. LinkedIn = benchmark, X/dev = starter.
emily: I'll craft short-form captions for each and supply a testimonial blur (anonymized) for the benchmark post. Will include alt text.
li: Routing rules: landing page must set cookie `launch_cohort=webinar_v1` from utm_campaign. If attendee && credit_claimed && usage>=3 in 7d -> tag sales:high. Registrant_no_show -> 4-email drip over 10d with sample prompts.
jon: Measurement: primary KPI = 7-day activation (>=3 meaningful API calls). Secondary = signup-to-credit-claim rate. Add events: `webinar_credit_reserved`, `webinar_credit_released`, `ran_starter_prompt`.
sam: Credit cadence suggestion: 40% on signup (reserve), 60% after attendance + first API call. Helps reduce ghost signups.
emily: I'll add UI copy for the modal explaining credits and show the three starter prompts: 'summarize-ticket', 'rewrite-for-exec', 'generate-tests'. Each gets a one-line example.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Micro Webinar: Inference Starter' Fri 09:00 PT. Invitees: maya, jon, sam, li, emily.
maya: Action items: Sam - post captions + images to Notion; Emily - starter prompt examples + modal copy; Li - routing doc + cookie spec; Jon - final agenda + metrics. Back here after design pass. :rocket:
